jobs.title: Field Marketing and Sales Support Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Carbon Robotics is the leader in physical AI for agriculture, helping farmers become more profitable and sustainable. Its flagship product, the LaserWeeder™, is the world’s leading commercial laser weeding system with hundreds of units operated by farmers in 15 countries worldwide.

LaserWeeder combines computer vision, AI, robotics, and high-powered lasers to identify weeds and destroy them with sub-millimeter precision—no herbicides, hand labor, or soil disturbance required. Growers achieve weed control cost reductions of up to 80% and crop yield increases of 5–50%, with payback in one to three years. The system is powered by Carbon AI’s Large Plant Model (LPM), trained on 150 million labeled plants, and can start weeding any crop or field in minutes.

The company's second product is Carbon Autonomy, the most dependable tractor autonomy solution. Carbon Autonomy includes a retrofit tractor autonomy kit for John Deere tractors, autonomy software, and remote supervision for real-time interventions if required.

Carbon Robotics is based in Seattle, Washington State, USA and has raised $185 million in capital since 2018 from leading investors including NVIDIA’s NVentures and BOND.

YouTube | X | Instagram | LinkedIn | News

Due to recent expansion in the ANZ region we are seeking a motivated and results-driven Field Marketing and Sales Support Specialist to support Carbon Robotics’ business growth through lead generation, customer engagement, and marketing activities. This role combines sales development and marketing support, helping to identify new opportunities, nurture customer relationships, and contribute to brand awareness initiatives.  

What you’ll do:

Field Marketing Responsibilities

  • Assist in the development, execution, and tracking of targeted marketing campaigns to maximize performance and engagement.

  • Support digital marketing initiatives, including email marketing and social media activities, while analyzing and reporting on key engagement metrics.

  • Create and distribute compelling marketing materials and promotional content to drive brand awareness.

  • Conduct market research and competitor analysis to inform outreach strategies and discover new pipeline opportunities.

  • Organise, participate in, and track the performance of trade shows, webinars, and customer events to maximize local lead generation.

Sales Responsibilities

  • Generate and qualify high-quality leads through outbound calls, emails, social media, and other prospecting activities to directly build and grow our sales pipeline value.

  • Follow up on inbound enquiries to consistently convert prospects into qualified sales opportunities.

  • Schedule appointments and product demonstrations for the sales team to advance the pipeline.

  • Maintain accurate customer records in the CRM system to track pipeline movement and data health.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing customers to optimize customer engagement metrics.

  • Meet or exceed individual sales, lead-generation, and overall revenue contribution targets.

 

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities for Success:

  • 1–3 years' experience in inside sales, telesales, business development, or marketing.

  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills.

  • Experience using CRM systems such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google applications.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.

  • Strong customer service orientation, ability to troubleshoot and handle objections.

  • Good time management skills, with an ability to be a self-starter, work autonomously and show initiative.

  • Ability to travel within Australia, New Zealand and internationally as required.

  • Typical annual events include, but not limited to; NZ Hort Conference (July), Asia Fruit Logistica (September), Elmore Field Days (October), Future Hort Leaders (October), Hort Connections (June) and Fieldays NZ (June).  Each event is likely to occupy 3-7 days through travel to and from, setup in the field, the event and pack-up.

  • Flexible to work extended hours including weekends as required to support business needs.

  • Work closely with multiple internal stakeholders including logistics, marketing, service and sales personnel.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in B2B sales and marketing.

  • Knowledge of digital marketing platforms and social media advertising.

  • Relevant qualification in Business, Marketing, Sales, or a related field.

  • Understanding of the Australian agriculture market and customer landscape.

Why would you join Carbon Robotics?

Passion for building teams capable of solving uniquely interesting problems. Innovation while disrupting the market is what we do. Profiled in WSJ and Forbes, Carbon Robotics is poised to become the next billion dollar company in the rapidly growing worldwide Ag-Tech industry.

We offer competitive compensation and benefits to our full time US based* employees, including:

  • Competitive salaries

  • Pre-IPO Stock Options

  • Generous Benefits:

    • Fully-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums for you and all dependents

      • Choice of PPO or HDHP/HSA

      • Virtual Care - Doctor on Demand

      • Employee Assistance Program

    • Mental Health HRA

    • Restricted Healthcare Travel support

    • Menopause Support

    • Life Insurance

    • Long Term Disability

    • Flexible PTO

    • 401(k) plan

    • Pet Insurance

    • Commuter Benefits

  • Work Culture: Be a part of an inclusive and tight-knit company culture that values innovation and mission-driven success.

*Internationally based employees benefits varies & Contractors are not eligible for Carbon Robotics Benefits or Stock

Carbon Robotics is building a culture of diversity and inclusion for all. We welcome everyone’s voice and believe in open and transparent communication. We believe the best products, services, and companies are built by strong teams that include a diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, ideas, and experiences. We are committed to supporting and enabling growth and opportunity for every employee at every level. This is the foundation to which we will build a truly unique environment.

We are equally committed to equal employment opportunity, and it is foundational to how we recruit and hire our talented team. Employment is determined based upon capabilities and qualifications without discrimination on the basis of race, creed, color, religion, sex, gender identification and expression, marital status, military status or status as an honorably discharge/veteran, pregnancy (including potential pregnancy, pregnancy-related conditions, and childbearing), sexual orientation, age (40 and over), national origin, ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, physical, mental, or sensory disability , HIV/AIDS or hepatitis C status, genetic information, status as an actual or perceived victim of domestic violence, sexual assault, or stalking, or any other protected class as established by law.

YouTube | X | Instagram | LinkedIn | News

Material Handler – Job Description

Location: Richland, WA
Department: Supply Chain
Reports To: Inventory Control Manager

Role Overview

As a detail-oriented Material Handler at Carbon Robotics, you'll own the flow of materials through our Richland facility: receiving parts accurately, keeping inventory organized and traceable, and getting the right materials to production on time. You'll split your time between the warehouse floor and the system, and help drive accuracy, throughput, and accountability as we scale.

Key Responsibilities

Material Handling & Warehouse Operations

  • Pick, stage, and deliver materials to support production builds.

  • Replenish lineside inventory and WO’s based on planner signals.

  • Move materials to assigned storage locations.

  • Support inter-facility or intercompany transfers as needed.

Kitting & Staging

  • Build accurate kits for production orders, field units, and troubleshooting; escalate shortages to Planning or Purchasing.

  • Stage materials cleanly and in line with 5S standards.

Inventory Control

  • Complete NetSuite transactions for receipts, picks, put-aways, transfers, and authorized cycle-count adjustments, keeping serial- and lot-controlled items traceable.

  • Support cycle counts, bin audits, wall-to-wall counts, and root-cause analysis of variances.

  • Keep materials labeled, barcoded, and stored in organized, optimized locations.

Warehouse Organization & Safety

  • Maintain clean racking, kitting zones, MRB, and lineside racks; promptly dispose of pallet wood, cardboard, foam, and other packaging.

  • Operate forklifts and material-handling equipment safely, and follow all EHS and PPE guidelines.

  • Keep forklift aisles and material flow paths clear.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Inventory Control, Supply Chain, Production, Planning, Shipping, and Engineering to prioritize work and keep material flowing.

  • Flag shortages, late deliveries, and discrepancies early, and support urgent builds, shipments, and audits.

Qualifications

Required

  • 2+ years in warehouse, material handling, receiving, inventory, or production control, ideally in manufacturing.

  • Hands-on ERP experience (NetSuite preferred) and a working grasp of BOMs, work orders, and inventory transactions.

  • Ability to operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and carts, or willingness to get certified.

  • Strong attention to detail in picking, labeling, and transactions, and the discipline to follow standard work and keep accurate records.

  • Ability to lift 50 lbs repeatedly and stand or sit for extended periods.

  • Organized, reliable, and proactive, with strong ownership of accuracy and follow-through.

  • Clear communicator and team player who prioritizes well in a fast-paced, scaling environment.

  • Commitment to cleanliness, organization, and safety.

Preferred

  • Forklift certification and experience.

Why would you join Carbon Robotics?

Passion for building teams capable of solving uniquely interesting problems. Innovation while disrupting the market is what we do. Profiled in WSJ and Forbes, Carbon Robotics is poised to become the next billion dollar company in the rapidly growing worldwide Ag-Tech industry.

We offer competitive compensation and benefits to our full time US based* employees, including:

  • Competitive salaries

  • Pre-IPO Stock Options

  • Generous Benefits:

    • Fully-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums for you and all dependents

      • Choice of PPO or HDHP/HSA

      • Virtual Care - Doctor on Demand

      • Employee Assistance Program

    • Mental Health HRA

    • Restricted Healthcare Travel support

    • Menopause Support

    • Life Insurance

    • Long Term Disability

    • Flexible PTO

    • 401(k) plan

    • Pet Insurance

    • Commuter Benefits

  • Work Culture: Be a part of an inclusive and tight-knit company culture that values innovation and mission-driven success.

*Internationally based employees benefits varies & Contractors are not eligible for Carbon Robotics Benefits or Stock

We believe the best products, services, and companies are built by strong teams that include a diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, ideas, and experiences. We are committed to supporting and enabling growth and opportunity for every employee at every level. This is the foundation to which we will build a truly unique environment.

We are equally committed to equal employment opportunity, and it is foundational to how we recruit and hire our talented team. LaserWeeder combines computer vision, AI, robotics, and high-powered lasers to identify weeds and destroy them with sub-millimeter precision—no herbicides, hand labor, or soil disturbance required. The company's second product is Carbon Autonomy, the most dependable tractor autonomy solution. Carbon Autonomy includes a retrofit tractor autonomy kit for John Deere tractors, autonomy software, and remote supervision for real-time interventions if required.

YouTube | X | Instagram | LinkedIn | News

As a Software Engineering Manager (Frontend/Mobile) at Carbon Robotics, you’ll lead the team building the command center for the future of agriculture. You’ll sit at the intersection of AI, robotics, and user experience, translating deep technical complexity into intuitive, reliable tools that farmers depend on every day.

Working closely with world-class mechanical, electrical, and software engineers, you’ll guide the development of high-performance web platforms and rugged, mission-critical mobile applications. Your team’s work will be the primary interface between humans and our cutting-edge robotic systems operating in the real world.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You won’t just set direction, you’ll actively contribute to architecture, code, and execution. And when needed, you’ll go directly to the field to ensure our products perform where it matters most: on the farm.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead and grow a team building web and mobile applications that interface with both cloud services and robotic systems

  • Contribute directly to system architecture and code; this is a deeply technical, hands-on role

  • Partner cross-functionally with product managers and mechanical, electrical, and backend engineering teams

  • Drive execution across the full software development lifecycle: planning, design, implementation, testing, and deployment

  • Set priorities, allocate resources, and ensure projects are delivered on time and at a high standard

  • Resolve technical and organizational challenges across teams

  • Mentor engineers and elevate the team’s technical capabilities and output

  • Communicate progress, risks, and outcomes clearly to stakeholders across the company

  • Foster a culture of ownership, fast iteration, and high accountability in a startup environment

  • Participate in field testing, including on-site farm visits, to validate real-world performance

  • Build an in office culture (5 days/week)

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities for Success:

  • Experience managing frontend (TypeScript, React) and/or mobile (Flutter) engineering teams

  • Ability to operate as a Lead Engineer in your area of expertise

  • Strong understanding of deploying and maintaining web and mobile applications in systems that integrate with backend services and hardware/robotics

  • Excellent communication skills and comfort working across multidisciplinary teams

  • A leadership style that thrives in an in-office, highly collaborative environment

  • Willingness to spend time in the field

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience)

Why would you join Carbon Robotics?

Passion for building teams capable of solving uniquely interesting problems. Innovation while disrupting the market is what we do. Profiled in WSJ and Forbes, Carbon Robotics is poised to become the next billion dollar company in the rapidly growing worldwide Ag-Tech industry.

We offer competitive compensation and benefits to our full time US based* employees, including:

  • Competitive salaries

  • Pre-IPO Stock Options

  • Generous Benefits:

    • Fully-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums for you and all dependents

      • Choice of PPO or HDHP/HSA

      • Virtual Care - Doctor on Demand

      • Employee Assistance Program

    • Mental Health HRA

    • Restricted Healthcare Travel support

    • Menopause Support

    • Life Insurance

    • Long Term Disability

    • Flexible PTO

    • 401(k) plan

    • Pet Insurance

    • Commuter Benefits

  • Work Culture: Be a part of an inclusive and tight-knit company culture that values innovation and mission-driven success.

*Internationally based employees benefits varies & Contractors are not eligible for Carbon Robotics Benefits or Stock
